ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:
SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance is hereby amended by changing all of B3-1 Community Shopping District
symbols as shown on Map No. 9-M.

in the area bounded by:

A line 45.72 feet north of and parallel to West Dakin Street; North Central Avenue;

West Dakin Street; the alley next west of and parallel to North Central Avenue.

To those of a B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District

SECTION 2. This Ordinance takes effect after its passage and due publication.

Common address of property: 3936 N. Central Avenue
